test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following sportsperson has been bestowed the ‘Param Vishisht Seva Medal’ in the year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Neeraj Chopra has been honored with Param Vishisht Seva Medal.
 
• Neeraj Chopra, a javelin thrower, became only the second Indian to win an Olympic gold medal.
 
• At the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, he earned a gold medal in the Javelin Throw event.
 
• He became India's seventh medalist and first gold medalist in the Olympics, joining shooter Abhinav Bindra (2008 Beijing Games) as an individual gold medalist.
 
• India won 1 Gold, 2 Silver, and 4 Bronze medals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bajrang Punia** is related to Wrestling.

 
 
• He belongs to Haryana.
 
• He won the bronze medal at Tokyo Olympics.
 
 
 
• **India's star weightlifter Mirabai Chanu** won India's first medal at the Tokyo Olympics, winning a silver medal in 49kg weightlifting with a total lift of 202 kg.
 
• **Indian star shuttler PV Sindhu** has secured a bronze medal at the Tokyo Olympics, defeating China’s He Bing Jiao in Women’s Singles.
